referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset is applied for the disposal of 3-IV glazing of windows. ; UUID: d918e918-6539-4b05-80d4-cf9e22cef987
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset describes the disposal of 1.06m2 triple glazing (3-IV) (not laminated safety glass) in a municipal incineration. 80% of the glass goes for landfill, 20% to MSWI. 1.06m2 corresponds to 1m2 visible glass.

technology.text: The technology described involves the disposal of aluminium, rubber and glass of a 3-IV glazing in a municipal incineration plant (glass is partly landfilled).
